card.title: Parts Watch needs read-only access to Northline Motors
card.why: 64 motor parts would have no lead-time data. You can still build Proto 3 without it.
perms: Read part numbers, lead times and stock
So Parts Watch can flag late motor parts
To catch parts missing UN 38.3 or CE marks
card.never: No write access and no pricing. Tilo never sees your password: you sign in with Northline directly.

options.label: Allow read-only access
options.reason: Motor parts are 16% of the BOM

options.label: Not now
options.detail: Parts Watch shows motor rows as "no data"

card.title: Allow Tilo to read Supplier pricing?
card.why: Parts Watch would show negotiated prices, not list prices. Cost decisions get more accurate.
perms: Read negotiated unit prices for 412 parts
So price changes show up in Parts Watch
To warn before a price agreement expires

card.title: Voltacell cells slipped from 6 to 11 weeks. Proto 3 is at risk.
card.why: Proto 3 builds in week 22 and the cells now land in week 25. Rue and Mo disagree on the fix.

options.label: Expedite Voltacell at a premium
options.detail: €18,400 premium. Cells in 7 weeks. Keeps the date, uses 9% of the contingency.

options.label: Switch to the Kelvra alternate cell
options.detail: Same price. Passed Sample Lab tests in week 14. Needs one retest.
options.reason: Keeps the Proto 3 date with no premium, and the cell is already validated

options.label: Move the Proto 3 date
options.detail: Proto 3 moves 5 weeks and launch moves 3. No cost.
